proof_body:
by
  intro f g hf hg
  have hE : Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * p.1 * p.2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by fun_prop
  have hI : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * p.1 * p.2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (f p.1 * g p.2)) (MeasureTheory.volume.prod MeasureTheory.volume) := by
    refine (hf.mul_prod hg).bdd_mul (c := 1) hE.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun p => ?_)
    rw [Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
  calc ∫ w : ℝ, (∫ v : ℝ, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * f v) * g w
      = ∫ w : ℝ, ∫ v : ℝ, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (f v * g w) := by
        congr 1; funext w
        rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_mul_const]
        congr 1; funext v; ring
    _ = ∫ v : ℝ, ∫ w : ℝ, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (f v * g w) := by
        exact (MeasureTheory.integral_integral_swap (f := fun w v => Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (f v * g w)) hI.swap).symm ▸ rfl
    _ = ∫ v : ℝ, f v * ∫ w : ℝ, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * g w := by
        congr 1; funext v
        rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
        congr 1; funext w; ring
target_source: ∀ f g : ℝ → ℂ, MeasureTheory.Integrable f MeasureTheory.volume → MeasureTheory.Integrable g MeasureTheory.volume → ∫ w : ℝ, (∫ v : ℝ, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * f v) * g w = ∫ v : ℝ, f v * ∫ w : ℝ, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * g w
